Guided walkthrough – each step switches person

Click a step to become that person and open the right record. Try doing a step as the wrong person to see the rule that blocks it.

Workflow 1 · Onboarding a new crew member

  1. Sarah Jenkins (HR Lead) – HR chases Jordan Reed’s overdue occupational health and references, and verifies the DBS the candidate uploaded.
  2. Dr. Helen Price (Governance & IPC Lead) – Governance verifies Kiran Shah’s safeguarding certificate – HR uploaded it, so HR is blocked from verifying it.
  3. Sarah Jenkins (HR Lead) – HR submits Kiran Shah for approval once every check is green.
  4. Dr. A. Vance (Registered Manager) – The Registered Manager approves Maya Collins as Technician (or returns the file with a reason).
  5. Sarah Jenkins (HR Lead) – HR marks Maya active; the planner now checks her readiness on every shift.

Workflow 1 · Training & supervision

  1. Sarah Jenkins (HR Lead) – HR verifies group manual-handling session TS-031, which brings Lee Davies back into date.
  2. Sarah Jenkins (HR Lead) – HR confirms Alex Morgan’s supervision request and rebooks Lee’s missed one.
  3. Alex Morgan (Crew – Paramedic / Driver) – Alex uploads a certificate, requests supervision and asks for a correction.

Workflow 2 · Ambulance checks and defects

  1. Alex Morgan (Crew – Paramedic / Driver) – Alex does a daily check on AMB-05 and fails a critical item – a stop-use defect is raised and the vehicle blocked.
  2. Priya Nair (Dispatcher) – The dispatcher reallocates the blocked vehicle’s jobs.
  3. Dave Evans (Fleet Lead) – The Fleet Lead signs off the AMB-03 tail-lift repair.
  4. Dave Evans (Fleet Lead) – The Fleet Lead tries to return AMB-02 to service – blocked: a second person must.
  5. Dr. A. Vance (Registered Manager) – The Registered Manager returns AMB-02 to service.
  6. Dr. A. Vance (Registered Manager) – The Registered Manager verifies AMB-05’s insurance renewal.
  7. Priya Nair (Dispatcher) – The dispatcher runs the readiness check before allocating a crew.

Workflow 3 · Incidents, investigation, audits

  1. Alex Morgan (Crew – Paramedic / Driver) – Alex reports an incident (try ticking “someone still at risk”).
  2. Dr. Helen Price (Governance & IPC Lead) – Governance triages the oxygen near miss, investigates, records learning and raises actions.
  3. Dr. A. Vance (Registered Manager) – The Registered Manager records the CQC submission and duty-of-candour steps for the carry-chair fall.
  4. Dr. Helen Price (Governance & IPC Lead) – Governance verifies ACT-218 evidence and conducts the AUD-104 recruitment audit.
  5. Dave Evans (Fleet Lead) – The Fleet Lead uploads evidence for an action from the audit.
  6. Dr. A. Vance (Registered Manager) – The Registered Manager sees what is escalating and sets a deputy.
  7. J. Whitmore (External auditor (read-only)) – The external auditor reads the inspection view (read-only, logged).
